modalities.evidence: free text triage nurse chief complaints

output.population: Chief complaints collected from 2019 to 2020 at an academic medical center in the Deep South, from an urban Black majority Emergency Department patient population
output.summary: Two corpora of free-text emergency department triage chief complaints annotated for gout flare status by retrospective manual review, with a subset verified through rheumatologist chart review, intended for natural language processing work.
